title: Production entrypoint runs Flask with debug=True bound to 0.0.0.0
evidence: app.py:176 app.run(debug=True, host='0.0.0.0', port=5000) — debug mode exposes the Werkzeug interactive debugger/PIN on all interfaces
suggestion: Disable debug and bind to 127.0.0.1 for anything but local dev, or gate via an env var

title: Author filter uses SQL LIKE substring match rather than exact equality
evidence: app.py:102 'SELECT * FROM books WHERE author LIKE ?' with f'%{author_filter}%' — 'Orwell' matches 'George Orwell'
suggestion: None required; substring match is a reasonable superset of the spec and is what the pinned tests exercise
